critique: The digital papercraft aesthetic is beautifully executed, utilizing overlapping warm-toned CSS cutouts, soft drop shadows, and multiply-blended window grids to create a deep, tactile architectural collage. However, relying on external, non-existent image files (`art.png` and `guineapig.png`) results in broken icons that disrupt the immersion; replacing these with generative canvas drawings or inline SVGs would preserve the self-contained integrity of the piece.
